title: Optimization Concierge: weighted request classifier and escalation triggers
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: Build a deterministic, auditable intake funnel and weighted-classifier that auto-routes optimization and advisory requests (batching/caching knobs, quantization profiles, routing policies) into the correct handling lane: self-serve guidance, light advisory, concierge engagement, or engineering commitment. Goal: reduce triage lag for enterprise requests, ensure consistent prioritization across PM/Eng/SE teams, and provide clear escalation triggers for executive review.

Scope:
- Define a weighted scoring rubric with explicit factors and thresholds (revenue impact, projected per-token cost delta, SLA sensitivity, data sensitivity/compliance, estimated engineering effort, frequency of occurrence).
- Implement intake form changes in Linear to capture required signals (example fields included below).
- Provide automation to compute score and assign lane; create follow-up task templates for each lane.
- Define escalation triggers that create an exec-notification (Slack + email + docket entry) when thresholds are exceeded.
- Expose a lightweight review UI for PM/SE to override automated lane decisions with an audit trail.

Weighted rubric (proposed):
- Revenue sensitivity (0-40): ARR/KPI impact estimate, customer tier multiplier.
- Cost delta per 1M tokens (0-25): estimated savings if optimization applied.
- SLA/latency sensitivity (0-15): fraction of requests with < target latency.
- Compliance/privacy (0-10): PII/regulated data flag.
- Estimated engineering effort (0-10): quickness to implement (lower effort increases score).
Scoring buckets (examples): 0-29 self-serve, 30-54 advisory-lite (SE consultation), 55-79 concierge (dedicated engagement), 80+ engineering-commit + exec notification.

Acceptance criteria:
- Intake form captures all rubric inputs and is used in >90% of incoming optimization requests.
- Automated classifier correctly routes historical sample of 200 past requests with >=85% agreement with PM panel.
- Override UI built and accessible to PM/SE with logging of changes.
- Escalation events fire to exec channel when threshold crossed and include a one-line rationale and links to artifacts.
- Metrics dashboard (Grafana) reporting time-to-route, lane distribution, and advisory throughput.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: building the full advisory delivery tooling (separate follow-ups owned by ENG-5123 / ENG-5211).
